name: Goodman (McELHANY)
summary: Wooden 60-ft tower erected 1947 near Goodman, replaced by a 120-ft steel tower in FY1958-59; the page says it was moved to private land. A Joplin Globe feature disagrees.
design: Wooden tower erected 1947, replaced in FY1958-59 by a 120-foot steel tower
status_note: The Forest Lookouts page says the tower was 'Removed to private location.' It gives no date and does not say where the structure now stands. A Joplin Globe feature (undated copy) says the towers near Lanagan and Goodman still offer the public a view and MDC still looks after them.

access.note: The tower was removed to a private location. The 40-acre MDC Goodman Towersite is public land, open 4:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily, but the page does not mention a tower there.

events.note: 40 acres acquired for a towersite (page gives 1946-1947, citing a Missouri Department of Conservation annual report).

A new 60-foot wooden tower was erected, June 28, 1947, per the page. A July 23, 1947 newspaper item quoted there says materials were still on the grounds and completion was probably not much before fall.
By the July 23, 1947 item, Towerman Mauch and his family had already moved into the McElhany farm at the tower site.
Wooden tower replaced by a 120-foot steel tower (fiscal 1958-59, per a Missouri Conservation Commission annual report quoted on the page).
